notes.title: Midtris (V0.25 - V0.26)
notes.content:
Game build just got approved! Included few changes recommended by Steam.


 Improved Korean translations
 Cursor now disappears instantly when starting new game (previously 5 second delay)
 Game will now pause when steam overlay is activated
 Fixed pusher sometimes failing to push blocks when moving to multiple directions at once
 Fixed rotate symbol locations in game selection menu when using controller

notes.title: Midtris (V0.23- V0.24)
notes.content:
Improved Japanese & Russian translations
 Fixed taking double damage when 5-line piece was placed side ways on top of the spawning line (Made spawn line explosion wider)
 Fixed flame not having particle effects when colliding side ways with corner blocks

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is coming soon so demo has been updated!

Update (Midtris V0.16 - V0.22)


 Bombastic mode is now available in demo
 3 more blocks and challenges are available in demo
 Added grid color, background color & ghost block color options
 Increased thickness of spawn line grid
 Added description for locking delay option
 Added translations for full screen
 [Added small delay when taking damage
 Fixed some bomb related bugs
 Lot of other fixes

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.content:
Demo is now available! Try out classic mode for free!

Small update for the demo. Leaderboards are now public in demo, at least until the game's actual release. Also included some of the recent changes.


Update (Midtris V0.13 - V0.15)

 Added control window to game mode selection menu
 Removed "Blocks can be rotated" text from game mode descriptions
 Your previously selected difficulty option is now saved
 Difficulty options are no longer visible when "BACK" is selected
 Some other small fixes
 Changed control window/button position (Button got in the way of difficulty description)
 Changed board position in rules page
 Fixed repeating menu button sounds in leaderboards
 Improved French translations
 Moved descriptions in game mode selection to make space for translations
 Increased gap between columns in control, graphics and audio options
 Changed text positions in UI
 Fixed pause menu outline when playing extremist mode
 Fixed players name sometimes not being highlighted in leaderboards

notes.title: Midtris (V0.10 - V0.12)
notes.content:
Added new custom difficulty option where you can start the game from highest difficulty that you have reached. See how high you can climb and practice higher difficulties! 

(Midtris V0.10)
-Piece locking timer now also applies to bombs (Pusher and flame will lose all 10 stacks upon first contact)
-Piece locking timer no longer reset when rotating blocks that cannot be rotated
-Fixed pusher not working properly with mouse controls
-Mouse controls now apply even when cursor is outside the board
-Fixed dropping sometimes not locking piece
-Reduced amount of particle effects when dropping pusher

(Midtris V0.11)
-Added locking delay option (Prevents pieces from instantly locking in place when soft dropping)
-Renamed rotate and reverse rotate to rotate right and rotate left
-Changed locking timer from 2+(50% of current speed) to 10+(35% of current speed)
-Fixed dropping sometimes not locking pieces in place (For real this time)

(Midtris V0.12)
-Added custom difficulty option (You must unlock hard mode to select this)
-Hard mode is now unlocked for each game mode separately
-Improved German and Spanish translations
-Added second page to credits (Still in progress)
-Fixed using drop resetting mouse hide timer
-Added some missing menu button sounds

notes.title: Midtris (V0.09)
notes.content:
Beta testing has just started. Here are some changes based on feedback so far. 

Added piece locking timer that will add some extra time when moving/rotating piece when it is about to land. This should make game more forgiving when it comes to misdrops and give some extra time to move pieces to the side when spawning area is blocked.



 Added piece locking time when moving/rotating pieces when they are 1 block away from landing (Max 10 times)
 Added customizable mouse controls
 Interlapping keybindings now change positions (Arrow keys are still hard coded for movement)
 Changed pusher sound effect
 Fixed dropping flame not working with gamepad
 Fixed there not being "wobble" delay with mouse controls when holding block



Let me know if you are interested of becoming beta tester!
